values.name: Petar Klovar
values.bio: Petar Klovar is a Croatian freediver from Rijeka and a member of the city’s Ocean diving club. He holds AIDA world records in Free Immersion, Constant Weight No Fins and Constant Weight Bi-Fins, and in 2025 he broke William Trubridge’s long-standing no-fins record. He was ranked world no. 2 by AIDA in 2025 and has also served as an AIDA judge since 2022.
